command_position: Exact first line; all remaining input preserved in request digest and intent contract.
feedback_episode: Most recently recorded adapter outcome must be completed, not interrupted.
persistence: Existing ARE append-only file-fsync reasoning ledger under exclusive writer lock; reserve prompt before lifecycle changes and checkpoint projection before stdout.
errors: Exit 1, stdout {}, diagnostic on stderr; withhold ARE guidance, not a guaranteed host prompt block.
duplicate_policy: Reject repeated or changed prompt in same turn, including uncertain prior delivery; no automatic retry.
stop: Record completion and return {}; never request continuation.
limitations: Configuration and input fields are not authentication
No native-host invocation, reload, steering coverage or model delivery proof
No power-loss fault injection; process restart tested
